title: Mage-VL-Cowork：通过进化式执行框架学习混合计算机使用的完整训练方案
summary: 提出4B混合计算机使用智能体Mage-VL-Cowork，通过五阶段渐进式课程（中期训练、SFT、RL）训练，配合Mage-CUA-Forge合成29万+任务，在OSWorld-Verified上达到66.0%，同参数量下达到SOTA。
summary_en: Presents Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid computer-use agent trained via a progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL, powered by Mage-CUA-Forge which synthesizes 293,806 tasks across 6,915 skills while cutting per-task cost by 82.6%; achieves 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified, state-of-the-art at its parameter size.
